mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over the last two months indicates a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last two months signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% within the last month signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) also increases, it indicates a strong supply-side response to demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% QoQ and INDPRO increases
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
